lodging_name: YMCA of the Rockies — Estes Park Family Resort and Cabins
before_after:
More details to come, but currently the plan is that many people will be in town starting Tuesday July 7th, so we will likely plan a meet and greet dinner for any family and friends that would like to attend either the night of the 7th or 8th prior to the wedding which will be on Thursday July 9th.

For the days following the wedding we are planning to stay at YMCA of the Rockies at Estes Park through Tuesday July 14th. There are many lodging options there, including cabins and rooms at a lodge, but the idea is we can all stay after the wedding if desired and do some fun stuff around Estes and RMNP.

Feel free to reach out if you'd like to try coordinating for AirBnb or YMCA cabins close together as that's where Lilith, the kids, Gen and much of her family will be staying.
